instructions: Think about your teen over the past month. For each moment, pick the ONE answer that sounds most like your teen right now, even if more than one fits. There are no wrong answers: every choice is a strength.
frequency_stem: In the past month, how often does your teen...

scenarios.prompt: A free evening all to themselves. Your teen is most likely to...

options.text: read, write, or work on an essay, story or blog
work on a strategy game, a coding project or a logic puzzle
draw, edit photos or video, or redo their space

scenarios.prompt: In a group (co-op class, youth group, a team), your teen shines when...

options.text: there is something physical to do: build, play, compete
there is music: worship team, choir or a band
they can lead, encourage, or pull the group together

scenarios.prompt: On a hike or camping trip, your teen...

options.text: likes to hang back and have some quiet time alone
knows, or wants to know, the plants, birds and trees
ends up in deep talks about God, creation or purpose

scenarios.prompt: When your teen is stressed, they usually...

options.text: talk it out, or write it down
work it off: exercise, build, cook or fix something
pull back for a while to think it through alone

scenarios.prompt: Planning a family trip, your teen is the one who...

options.text: builds the schedule, the budget or the packing list
makes the playlist for the drive
finds the trails, parks, farms or wildlife to see

scenarios.prompt: At church or youth group, your teen is most drawn to...

options.text: the creative side: slides, stage design, photos or art
the people: mentoring younger kids or talking with adults
the teaching, and wrestling with hard questions afterward

scenarios.prompt: Late at night, your teen is most likely to...

options.text: be reading, writing, or deep in a good story
be listening to, playing, or writing music
want to talk about faith, meaning, or what is right

scenarios.prompt: In a group project, your teen naturally...

options.text: sets up the plan, the numbers or the system
keeps everyone working together and feeling heard
takes one piece and does it on their own

scenarios.prompt: Your teen's dream summer job or project would be...

options.text: something creative: design, photos or decorating
something hands-on: building, repairing, cooking or a trade
something outdoors: a farm, a vet clinic or a park

scenarios.prompt: With friends, your teen is usually the one who...

options.text: tells the stories everyone remembers
notices who is left out and pulls them in
gets everyone outside: hiking, fishing or caring for animals

scenarios.prompt: Faced with a hard problem, your teen...

options.text: breaks it down logically, step by step
tries things with their hands until something works
asks what the right thing to do is, and why

scenarios.prompt: Given an hour alone, your teen is most likely to...

options.text: sketch, design, or build something detailed
practice an instrument, sing, or write a song
journal, reflect, or set goals for themselves

frequency.text: read, write, or play with words for fun
enjoy puzzles, numbers, logic, or figuring out how things work
draw, design, or picture how something will look before making it
build, fix, cook, or make things with their hands
sing, play music, or notice sounds and rhythms
help, lead, or encourage the people around them
want time alone to think or set their own goals
care for or explore plants, animals and the outdoors
ask big questions about God, purpose, or right and wrong
